catalog.moat_and_risks: De facto monopoly: CUDA, a 20-year software moat, is impossible to replace in the short term. Backlog of ~$500B through 2027; tactical investments ($5B in Intel, a stake in CoreWeave) shore up both its supply chain and its demand.
catalog.role: Undisputed leader in GPUs and AI accelerators; the most valuable node in the entire chain.
catalog.source: Khipus supply-chain graph snapshot (data/grafo_v0.json, curated catalog) — descriptive text curated by Khipus; figures inside may be approximate
catalog.supplies: Blackwell GPUs and the ramping Vera Rubin platform, plus NVLink/Spectrum-X networking, for hyperscalers, CoreWeave, AI labs and governments. Its CUDA software platform locks in the entire ecosystem.

network_risk_score.explain: Network Risk Score 0-100 (higher = more fragile position in the AI supply chain): country/geo risk + graph centrality + margin + fundamentals + concentration. A heuristic, not a forecast.
network_risk_score.method: catalog formula via hot view V3 card (same formula as the app computeNRS; structural degree = flow relations, distinct pairs, of the current graph generation)
